Yoko Fujita  
📞 +81 90-1234-5678 | 📧 yoko.fujita@example.com | 📍 Tokyo, Japan  

**Professional Experience / Work History**  
At Lumina Interactive, I spearheaded the architecture of microservices for cross-platform game synchronization, leveraging gRPC to reduce latency by 40% during peak load. My work on Redis clusters ensured session persistence across 10+ game servers, scaling to handle 50,000 concurrent users. Previously, at Aether Studios, I designed PostgreSQL schemas for persistent game data, enabling seamless multiplayer experiences in titles with over 2 million monthly active players. Early in my career, as a Game Server Intern at Nexu Games, I optimized matchmaking algorithms in C#, improving average queue times by 30% while implementing REST APIs to track player stats across 15+ game titles.  

**Technical Skills / Technologies**  
Node.js: Engineered real-time multiplayer features for a AAA title, integrating WebSockets and Redis to support 10,000 simultaneous connections.  
Python: Automated deployment pipelines using Ansible, cutting manual configuration time by 60% across 8 environments.  
REST API design: Built scalable APIs for player stats tracking, handling 500,000+ requests daily with consistent <100ms latency.  
React: Redesigned the admin dashboard for a live service, improving developer productivity by 50% through component-based architecture.  
TypeScript: Refactored legacy backend codebases, reducing bug density by 25% and improving maintainability.  
MongoDB: Implemented sharded databases for user analytics, supporting 10TB of data with sub-second query response times.  
Docker: Containerized microservices for deployment, reducing environment setup time by 70% for new team members.  
Webpack/Vite: Optimized build pipelines, cutting deployment times from 15 minutes to 3 minutes for core game modules.  
C#/.NET: Developed matchmaking systems in C#, achieving 99.9% reliability during global launches.  
HTML/CSS: Styled lightweight UI components for internal tools, ensuring cross-browser compatibility.

Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | Tokyo Institute of Technology | Graduated 2020

English (native), Japanese (fluent), Korean (basic)

**Awards & Achievements**  
Recognized as Lumina Interactive’s “Innovation Architect” for pioneering gRPC-based synchronization across platforms. Launched a player retention tool using Python and MongoDB, contributing to a 15% increase in monthly active users. Featured in GameDev News for optimizing C# matchmaking systems, reducing server costs by $200k annually. Named Aether Studios’ “Rapid Prototyper” for delivering a real-time stats dashboard in under two weeks.
